# The Light Within

> An interactive, cinematic 3D Diwali experience at https://diwali.elixpo.com, created by Arya Bhagat and featured by Elixpo.

Visitors light a clay diya in a midnight courtyard, watch a procedural rangoli bloom and hundreds of lamps rise, set off fireworks, and write a Diwali blessing card that can be shared as a link.

## Modes

- Explore: orbit the courtyard and the hero diya.
- Illuminate: light the diya and expand its glow.
- Celebrate: launch aerial shells and ground fireworks (anar, chakri, phuljhadi).
- Blessings: create a calligraphy greeting card; share it with ?to=, ?from= and ?msg= parameters.

## Links
